research.title: Surface Defect Classification Under Variable Illumination
bullets: Prepared surface inspection images by checking defect labels, standardizing image dimensions, and organizing training and evaluation splits by acquisition session.
Implemented assigned histogram of oriented gradients and linear classifier baselines, comparing preprocessing settings and reviewing misclassified images across lighting conditions.

projects.title: Nearest-Neighbor Baselines for Handwritten Digit Recognition
bullets: Implemented nearest-neighbor classification using normalized pixel features, with consistent preprocessing for training, validation, and held-out handwritten digit images.
Compared distance metrics and neighborhood sizes on validation data, then inspected confusion matrices to identify frequently confused digit shapes.

projects.title: Color Histogram Baselines for Scene Classification
bullets: Constructed global and spatially partitioned color histograms from scene images and trained support vector machine baselines using scikit-learn.
Compared histogram binning and feature normalization choices using a fixed validation split, inspecting errors associated with visually similar scene categories.
